description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and causing you to gain one life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping the Thopter, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Repeat.
